youtube.title: Mahadev Ka Gala Neela Kyun Hai? 🔱 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Samudra manthan mein amrit se pehle nikla Halahal vish, jo poori srishti ko jala sakta tha. Mahadev ne woh vish pee liya, aur Mata Parvati ne unka gala thaam liya. Isiliye Mahadev kehlaaye Neelkanth.

Katha ka strot: Bhagavat Puran aur Shiv Puran.

Devlok Katha: Puranon aur mahakavyon ki kathayein, lok-chitron mein.
